title: Спор о высоком искусстве  (An Argument About High Art)

segments.t: Barinov demands that Nagiyev shut down his noisy movie shoot in case a Michelin inspector visits the restaurant today, but Nagiyev boasts that Eleonora gave him full permission to film.
Витя, ну ты видишь, что творится?
Да никто не придет, я охрану выставлю.
А где у вас тут это в сценарии?
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'We have a set change, Dmitry Vladimirovich.' The grammar packs 'at' and 'reset' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Dima, wrap up this circus.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'Dima' before landing on 'farce'. Dmitry Nagiyev answers right away.
Витя, ну ты видишь, что творится?
'Vitya, well do you see what is going on?' Notice the reflexive suffix on the verb meaning 'is going on', turning the action back on the subject.
'Go on, you see we are elevating art.' Dmitry Nagiyev anchors the line on 'go', while 'raise' completes the thought.
'And what if a critic comes?' Chef Barinov raises the pitch on 'will arrive' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Dmitry Nagiyev answers right away.
Да никто не придет, я охрану выставлю.
'Nobody will come, I will post security.' Dmitry Nagiyev brings out the contrast between 'yes' and 'nobody' in a few short words.
'That is it, Elya gave me permission.' In Russian, the idea of 'all' flows naturally into 'to allow' without extra filler words.
'Get out of here, do not get in the way.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'go' and finishing on 'disturb'. Chef Barinov answers right away.
А где у вас тут это в сценарии?
'And where do you have that in the script?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'and' and finishing on 'script'.
'That is me improvising.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'this' before landing on 'improvise'.
'Go on, mind your own business.' Notice how Russian expresses 'come on' and 'task' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Guys, let's focus!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'guys' before landing on 'let us focus'. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Витя, ну ты видишь, что творится?
Да никто не придет, я охрану выставлю.
А где у вас тут это в сценарии?
With security blocking the doors for Nagiyev's movie, the restaurant is left without a single guest for the day. See you in the next scene.
